developer.bio: By day, Karat is a biomedical and research scientist. His research has taken him to places like Texas A&M University and the University of Vermont. He writes software for the fun of solving his own problems, and Glyph is one of those tools.

developerMode.label: Advanced settings
developerMode.description: Adds a Developer tab under Application with tools like the attachment browser and diagnostic logging. Off by default.

updates.descriptionLoading: Checking whether this build can use automatic updates.
updates.descriptionUnknown: Glyph could not determine whether this build can use automatic updates.
updates.descriptionAuto: Check for new releases and install them without leaving Glyph.
updates.upToDate: You're already on the latest version.
updates.ready: v{{version}} is downloaded and ready. Click the update button to install it.

licenseStatus.label: License status
licenseStatus.description: Glyph could not verify the current license state in this window, so update actions are unavailable right now.

appUpdates.label: App updates
appUpdates.description: Checks immediately and downloads the latest published version in the background. Installation only happens when you choose it.

alpha.label: Alpha releases
alpha.description: Get early access to alpha builds. These may be unstable, so only turn this on if you’re comfortable testing unfinished releases.

communityBuild.label: Community build
communityBuild.description: You’re using the community, open source version of Glyph. Buy an official license to support Glyph’s development and get the latest updates automatically.

status.label: Status
status.description: Latest updater activity from this window.

changelog.label: Changelog
changelog.description: Open the published Glyph changelog in your browser.

attachments.title: Attachment browser
attachments.description: Find attachments no note links to and move them to the Trash. Turn off Advanced settings in About to hide this tab.
attachments.noSpace: Open a space to browse its attachments.

summary.facts: {{unused}} of {{total}} attachments aren't linked from any note · {{size}} total · {{notes}} notes checked
summary.clearFacts: {{total}} attachments, all linked from at least one of {{notes}} notes.

attachments.emptyUnused: No unused attachments. Every file is linked from at least one note.
attachments.footnote: A file counts as used when any note mentions its file name, in a link, an embed, HTML, or frontmatter. Files go to the macOS Trash, so you can put them back.

confirm.description: This frees {{size}}. Glyph checks again first and keeps any file a note links to now. You can put files back from the Trash in Finder.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Record what Glyph is doing so you can send the logs along with a bug report. Logs stay on this Mac. Glyph never sends them anywhere.

logging.label: Diagnostic logging
logging.description: Records app events, errors, and crashes while you reproduce a problem. Glyph keeps about 10 MB and deletes the oldest lines first. Turn it off when you're done.

export.label: Export logs
export.description: Saves a zip with the logs, recent Glyph crash reports from macOS, and your Glyph and macOS versions. Logs can include file and folder names from your space, so look them over before you send them. Your home folder appears as ~.

clear.label: Clear logs
clear.description: Deletes the diagnostic logs saved on this Mac.

defaultFolder.label: Folder
defaultFolder.description: New notes are created in this folder.

language.label: Language
language.description: Applies immediately to menus, settings, and navigation.
language.communityNotice: Translations are community-contributed and may be incomplete. Questions or improvements? <discord>Join Discord</discord>.

dateFormat.label: Date format
dateFormat.description: Applies immediately to complete dates in notes, metadata, databases, and history.

openPreviousTabs.label: Open previous tabs
openPreviousTabs.description: Start this space with the tabs you left open.

experimental.sectionDescription: Experimental features that are not fully fleshed out. A later version of Glyph may change or remove them.

noteSidePeek.label: Note peek
noteSidePeek.description: Wiki links and All Notes open as a Peek over the current tab instead of replacing it. Expand the Peek to go to that note, or close it to stay where you were. The file tree and command palette still open tabs.

zenMode.label: Zen mode
zenMode.description: Hide the sidebars, tabs, editor controls, and formatting ribbon so only your note remains.

defaultEditorMode.label: Default editor mode
defaultEditorMode.description: How notes open by default: Rich for editing, Preview for read-only viewing, or Raw for plain Markdown.

focusMode.label: Focus mode
focusMode.description: Dim inactive text in the main Rich editor while keeping your current writing unit clear.

tableOfContents.label: Table of contents
tableOfContents.description: Show a floating table of contents for each note.

showFrontmatter.label: Show frontmatter in editor
showFrontmatter.description: Display YAML frontmatter at the top of notes while editing. Turning this off keeps frontmatter available to indexing and databases.

headingPrefixes.label: Heading prefixes
headingPrefixes.description: Show H1–H6 labels beside headings in the rich text editor.

colorfulHeadings.label: Colorful headings
colorfulHeadings.description: Use a selected color palette for H1–H6 while editing notes.

collapsibleHeadings.label: Collapsible headings
collapsibleHeadings.description: Show collapse toggles on note headings in editor and preview.

collapsibleLists.label: Collapsible lists
collapsibleLists.description: Show collapse toggles on nested lists in editor and preview.

spellCheck.label: Spell check
spellCheck.description: Underline typos as you type. Right-click a word to see spelling suggestions.

rawLivePreview.label: Live Markdown in raw mode
rawLivePreview.description: Hide Markdown punctuation outside the active construct. Works with Vim. Click to edit; Command-click to follow links.

vimMode.title: Vim mode
vimMode.label: Vim mode
vimMode.info: Vim Mode is available only in Raw Markdown mode.

formatBar.label: Formatting bar
formatBar.description: Show the bottom formatting bar in Rich editor mode.

folderCounts.label: Show folder file counts
folderCounts.description: Show a recursive file total at the end of each folder row in the file tree.

sort.label: File tree sort
sort.description: Choose how folders and files are ordered in the sidebar tree.

week.label: Weekly notes
week.description: One note for this ISO week.

beautifulTags.label: Beautiful tags
beautifulTags.description: Show tags with the experimental beautiful tags style.

editorWidth.label: Editor width
editorWidth.description: Compact keeps lines shorter, Comfortable gives a little bit more room, and Wide uses the full editor width.

folder.label: Template folder
folder.description: Choose a folder inside the current space that contains your markdown templates.

trialStatus.label: Trial status
trialStatus.description: Remaining time on the current trial for this device.

officialBuild.label: Official build
officialBuild.description: Thanks for downloading and building Glyph yourself. Community builds don't include automatic updates. To get the latest version, download the source again and rebuild, or get the official licensed build to support Glyph and unlock automatic updates.

activate.label: Activate Glyph
activate.description: Enter your license key to unlock Glyph permanently on this device.

help.label: Help
help.description: Questions about licensing, lost keys, or purchase issues.
